# AXIS

> AXIS (Agentically eXtensible Instruction Structures) is a placement grammar for code: seven concerns, each split into a definition (Essence) and a live counterpart (Expression), with rules that keep business logic pure, IO at the edge, and state under one owner. These pages are written for agents. Read the core first; fetch a reference only when the task needs it.

## Core

- [AXIS core](axis/SKILL.md): the model, the eight rules, where code goes, how to work in an existing repository (about 2705 tokens)

## References

- [recipe.md](axis/references/recipe.md): adding a feature: build order, type contracts, what to test at each layer (about 2429 tokens)
- [tests.md](axis/references/tests.md): worked test files for Actions, Adapters, commit validation and Impact (about 1559 tokens)
- [mistakes.md](axis/references/mistakes.md): ten wrong-and-right pairs and a review checklist (about 1828 tokens)
- [boundaries.md](axis/references/boundaries.md): when to split a Manager or a Facet; failure as data; the two-pass read (about 4463 tokens)
- [components.md](axis/references/components.md): precise definitions of the fourteen parts; AXIS beside MVC, Redux, CQRS, event sourcing (about 4382 tokens)
- [frontend.md](axis/references/frontend.md): the mapping for browser code (about 1470 tokens)
- [mapping.md](axis/references/mapping.md): the AXIS repo mapper: describe any existing repository in AXIS terms (about 3377 tokens)
- [generation-units.md](axis/references/generation-units.md): break a change into small, checkable contracts (about 1184 tokens)
- [example-spa.md](axis/references/example-spa.md): a complete browser example, one file per part (about 3775 tokens)
- [example-server.md](axis/references/example-server.md): a complete Node server example with runtime extension (about 4940 tokens)
- [codemaps.prompt.md](axis/references/codemaps.prompt.md): the CodeMaps navigation prompt, for broad maps of a large repository (about 2094 tokens)

## Tools

- [axis.py](axis/scripts/axis.py): scan a repo for signals, lint claimed-pure code, and validate, render, query and age-check a repo map. Python 3.8+, no dependencies
- [axis-map.example.json](axis/assets/axis-map.example.json): a complete map of a small service, to copy the shape from

## Install

- [axis.skill](axis.skill): all of the above as an installable Agent Skill
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): all of the above as one file (about 35003 tokens)
